DEN_undermine_overlord_continuous_focus.description: We must do what we can to resist and undermine our Overlords to ensure Danish sovereignty.
DEN_undermine_overlord_continuous_focus.title: Undermine Overlord Influence

ETH_strengthen_the_black_lions.description: Although we have lost land to the enemy, the fight must go on. The Black Lions are offering a great deal of resistance to the Italian’s and we should therefore support them anyway we can.
ETH_strengthen_the_black_lions.title: Strengthen the Black Lions

ETH_supporting_the_arbegnoch.description: Across [ROOT.GetName] there are patriots willing to take up arms against the [ITA.GetAdjective] invaders. We must do everything we can to support these brave men and women in crippling the [ITA.GetAdjective] war machine.
ETH_supporting_the_arbegnoch.title: Supporting the Arbegnoch

SWI_build_up_military_readiness.description: The task of preparing the Swiss population is never-ending. We cannot rest until the threat of invasion is gone, and it might never be. We must orient our nation towards defensive preparations without delay.
SWI_build_up_military_readiness.title: Build up Military Readiness

SWI_support_active_militias_continuous_f.description: Our citizens are armed and deployed into their local militias, it is everyone else's duty to support them however they can so we can keep the enemies of the confederation at bay
SWI_support_active_militias_continuous_f.title: Support Active Militias

continuous_air_production.description: We can reorganize our aviation industry to eliminate waste and streamline production.
continuous_air_production.title: Air Production

continuous_boost_freedom.description: By reorganizing our colonial bureaucracy and recruiting native administrators, we will, in time, be able to take charge of our own affairs.
continuous_boost_freedom.title: Increase Autonomy

continuous_naval_production.description: By focusing resources on our shipyards and exempting skilled shipbuilders from military service, we can dramatically reduce production time for ships.
continuous_naval_production.title: Naval Production

continuous_non_factory_construct.description: There is still a lot of slack in our construction industry. By focusing our attention on it, we can achieve a significant improvement in construction speed. Unfortunately, the production of machine tools has proven a major bottleneck in the expansion of our heavy industry, so they won't benefit from efforts in this area.
continuous_non_factory_construct.title: Construction Engineering

continuous_reduce_training_time.description: By creating specialized advanced training units within each division, we can deploy even divisions that would previously have been held back to finish training to the front.
continuous_reduce_training_time.title: Army Training

continuous_repair.description: We will form specialized repair teams from factory and construction workers and centrally control their deployment to improve reconstruction of damaged infrastructure.
continuous_repair.title: Construction Repair

continuous_suppression.description: By infiltrating the major resistance groups in occupied territory and turning their leaders, we can significantly reduce the amount of damage they can do.
continuous_suppression.title: Resistance Suppression

continuous_tech_share.description: We will encourage our research institutes and universities to reach out to their counterparts in allied countries. This will gain us a tech sharing bonus.
continuous_tech_share.title: Technology Sharing

fury_absorb_the_rival_fire.description: Defeat rival Fury and take its forces.
fury_absorb_the_rival_fire.title: Absorb the Rival Fire

fury_all_borders.description: Fury attacks every valid neighbor at once.
fury_all_borders.title: All Borders

fury_all_roads_are_front_roads.description: Every road carries troops and supplies toward another border.
fury_all_roads_are_front_roads.title: All Roads Are Front Roads

fury_capital_first_plans.description: Staff officers study frontier roads and prepare orders for the next advance.
fury_capital_first_plans.title: Frontier War Plans

fury_capital_guard.description: The first column secures the capital while other units prepare to advance.
fury_capital_guard.title: Capital Guard

fury_carry_the_orders_overseas.description: The war effort crosses the sea to new fronts.
fury_carry_the_orders_overseas.title: Carry the Orders Overseas

fury_census_of_taken_states.description: Officials count railways, factories, and towns in occupied territory.
fury_census_of_taken_states.title: Survey Occupied States

fury_claim_the_same_map.description: Two Fury countries race to conquer the same neighbor.
fury_claim_the_same_map.title: Claim the Same Victim

fury_conquest_coring.description: Occupation and compliance prepare conquered land for integration.
fury_conquest_coring.title: Conquest Coring

fury_continental_ignitions.description: Fury spreads beyond its original continent.
fury_continental_ignitions.title: Continental Ignitions

fury_core_by_administration.description: Integrate compliant territory through civilian administration.
fury_core_by_administration.title: Core by Administration

fury_core_by_march.description: Integrate territory by force and accept the cost of resistance.
fury_core_by_march.title: Core by March

fury_count_the_rifles.description: Rifles are assigned to the field columns.
fury_count_the_rifles.title: Count the Rifles

fury_cut_the_rail_before_the_war.description: Trucks carry ammunition and stores behind the columns as officers prepare the next advance.
fury_cut_the_rail_before_the_war.title: Motorised Supply Columns

fury_depot_cadres.description: Depot officers keep rifles and supplies moving to the front.
fury_depot_cadres.title: Depot Cadres

fury_depot_officers_without_leave.description: Permanent depot officers keep supplies moving to the front.
fury_depot_officers_without_leave.title: Depot Officers Without Leave

fury_field_columns.description: Infantry trains to move quickly across borders and keep fighting.
fury_field_columns.title: Field Columns

fury_first_target_files.description: Commanders compare nearby countries by strength and access.
fury_first_target_files.title: Choose the First Target

fury_first_war_office_orders.description: The War Office sends attack orders to the field columns.
fury_first_war_office_orders.title: First War Office Orders

fury_forced_march_tables.description: Forced marches keep troops on the road and replace delays.
fury_forced_march_tables.title: Forced March Tables

fury_forward_depots.description: Rail depots and captured warehouses supply the advance.
fury_forward_depots.title: Forward Depots

fury_fury_pact_command.description: The pact coordinates Fury attacks while each country keeps its own command.
fury_fury_pact_command.title: Fury Pact Command

fury_garrison_the_names.description: Garrisons hold occupied towns and guard their supply lines.
fury_garrison_the_names.title: Garrison Occupied Towns

fury_harden_the_columns.description: The columns improve their tactics after early defeats.
fury_harden_the_columns.title: Harden the Columns

fury_hardened_doctrine.description: Fury's forces follow a more disciplined campaign plan.
fury_hardened_doctrine.title: Hardened Doctrine

fury_joint_cadre_transfers.description: Fury countries exchange officers and supplies.
fury_joint_cadre_transfers.title: Joint Cadre Transfers

fury_last_fury_standing.description: One Fury command remains to lead the next attack.
fury_last_fury_standing.title: Last Fury Standing

fury_logistics_under_movement.description: Trains, trucks, and supplies move with the advancing columns.
fury_logistics_under_movement.title: Logistics Under Movement

fury_main_fury_pact.description: The strongest Fury country leads the pact.
fury_main_fury_pact.title: Main Fury Pact

fury_new_registry_offices.description: Garrisons hold conquered towns while civilian offices take shape.
fury_new_registry_offices.title: Occupation Offices

fury_no_neutral_map.description: The pact turns against countries that have stayed neutral.
fury_no_neutral_map.title: No Neutral Ground

fury_no_second_fury.description: The War Office will not tolerate another Fury command.
fury_no_second_fury.title: No Second Fury

fury_no_target_is_first.description: The War Office gives no neighbor priority. Fury attacks every available target.
fury_no_target_is_first.title: No Target Is First

fury_occupation_as_recruitment.description: Conquered territory supplies recruits for the war.
fury_occupation_as_recruitment.title: Occupation as Recruitment

fury_occupation_registers.description: Occupation forces hold seized districts and suppress resistance.
fury_occupation_registers.title: Occupation Administration

fury_officer_tables.description: Commanders plan routes, supplies, and replacements together.
fury_officer_tables.title: Officer Tables

fury_one_border_at_a_time.description: The War Office attacks one neighbor at a time.
fury_one_border_at_a_time.title: One Border at a Time

fury_open_the_war_office.description: The War Office directs troops, supplies, and attacks from the capital.
fury_open_the_war_office.title: Open the War Office

fury_partition_before_victory.description: The war offices coordinate their plans before the next campaign begins.
fury_partition_before_victory.title: Joint Campaign Plans

fury_rail_and_registry.description: Repair railways and restore supply across occupied territory.
fury_rail_and_registry.title: Rail and Occupation Supply

fury_rival_column.description: A rival Fury country gives the War Office a reason to move faster.
fury_rival_column.title: Rival Column

fury_second_war_table.description: A second Fury command makes cooperation useful and rivalry dangerous.
fury_second_war_table.title: Second War Table

fury_storm_columns.description: The columns train to cross borders quickly and regroup for the next attack.
fury_storm_columns.title: Storm Columns

fury_storms_on_all_fronts.description: The columns attack on every front, even when supplies run short.
fury_storms_on_all_fronts.title: Storms on All Fronts

fury_the_last_neighbor_has_fallen.description: Victories have carried Fury beyond its first frontier. Its commanders prepare to extend the war farther.
fury_the_last_neighbor_has_fallen.title: Beyond the Old Frontier

fury_the_next_neighbor.description: Commanders choose a new target as soon as a war ends.
fury_the_next_neighbor.title: The Next Neighbor

fury_the_other_fire_answers.description: Another Fury country joins the campaign.
fury_the_other_fire_answers.title: The Other Fire Answers

fury_three_war_offices.description: Separate commands direct attacks on several borders at once.
fury_three_war_offices.title: Three War Offices

fury_war_office_without_a_door.description: The War Office directs every unit toward the next conquest.
fury_war_office_without_a_door.title: The War Office in Motion

fury_weak_neighbor_doctrine.description: The War Office avoids stronger enemies until weaker neighbors are defeated.
fury_weak_neighbor_doctrine.title: Weak Neighbor Doctrine

fury_world_in_fury.description: Fury spreads to countries around the world.
fury_world_in_fury.title: World in Fury
